properties.site-address: Former Seaton Delaval County First School, Double Row, Seaton Delaval
properties.notes: Land formerly occupied by Seaton Delaval First School which relocated to a new site a number of years ago. All of the school buildings that previous occupied the site have now been demolished and it now comprises overgrown hardstanding. Redevelopment of the vacant site through development of 10 units permitted (16/00657/FUL). Scheme is for 4 flats and 6 detached houses. Development of 10 dwellings completed in 2019/20.
